title: UAAP: Acido’s rise to UST stardom comes as no surprise to coach Pido
summary: Amiel Acido has continued to rise for University of Santo Tomas, but no one is less surprised than head coach Pido Jarencio, who has always believed in the sweet-shooting Growling Tiger.
